title: RX-F2a: capture=rustc_json plumbing in RefactorRunStep::Command
content: RefactorRunStep::Command has an optional `capture: Option<CaptureSpec>` field. When `CaptureSpec::RustcJson`, the runner captures stdout of the command, parses it as line-delimited cargo `--message-format=json`, filters to `reason=compiler-message` entries, and surfaces a `CapturedDiagnosticsSummary` (count + severity_counts HashMap) on the step report. Non-JSON lines are silently skipped. RunCaptureContext stashes parsed diagnostics keyed by `"last"` for potential future use. No transaction semantics are changed.
rationale: RX-F2a phase of the refactor expansion: enables agents to run `cargo build --message-format=json` as a validation step and receive structured diagnostic counts without parsing raw cargo output themselves.
